allow: PowerShell($h = Invoke-RestMethod "https://sityvobana-2a717-default-rtdb.firebaseio.com/word_history.json"; $dates = $h.PSObject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object; "first: $\($dates[0]\)  last: $\($dates[-1]\)  count: $\($dates.Count\)"; $prev=$null; foreach\($d in $dates\){ if\($prev\){ $gap=\([datetime]$d - [datetime]$prev\).Days; if\($gap -gt 1\){ "GAP: $prev -> $d \($\($gap-1\) missing days\)" } }; $prev=$d })
